value.text:
- document:
  - main:
    - button "Learn more"
    - text: hark pro
    - paragraph: A new kind of system for getting things done. Whatever you need, let Hark handle it.
    - button "Continue with Google"
    - button "Continue with Apple"
    - text: or
    - textbox "Email address or phone number"
    - button "Continue" [disabled]
    - text: By continuing, you agree to our
    - link "Terms of Service":
      - /url: /terms
    - text: and acknowledge that your data will be processed in accordance with our
    - link "Privacy Policy":
      - /url: /privacy-policy
    - text: .
    - region "What Hark can do":
      - group "Feature slides. Use the left and right arrow keys to browse.":
        - group "1 of 10. Book me a trip to Mexico City next weekend. Find the cheapest flights and a nice hotel in Polanco."
        - group "2 of 10. I’m really craving some pizza. Can you order me a Margherita from my usual place?"
        - group "3 of 10. I’ve been putting off home insurance quotes. Find me competitive quotes with equivalent coverage, show me a comparison, and make the switch."
        - group "4 of 10. Can you find me a dentist who takes my insurance, and book a checkup?"
        - group "8 of 10. Find the cheapest flight from SFO to JFK this weekend, and book it for me."
        - group "9 of 10. Find me three things you can help me with now."
        - group "10 of 10. Could you find me a spot for my annual physical?"
    - iframe
    - heading "Make everyday easier" [level=2]
    - text: Chat with Hark in a single thread for whatever you need. Book a table for that birthday dinner, submit expenses from email receipts, or do quick research. Hark has persistent memory, so it tailors responses to actually be useful to you. Keep bigger undertakings like job searches or trip planning organized with Projects. All from the Hark Pro app on browser, iOS, and Android
    - img "Make everyday easier"
    - heading "Consider it handled by Hark Handoff" [level=2]
    - text: Hark’s computer use agent, Handoff, can use the internet just like you would. It can build websites, do research, place orders, make slides, you name it. All from its own secure computer with a full browser that’s individual to you.
    - img "Consider it handled by Hark Handoff"
    - heading "Rest assured it's Secured by hark" [level=2]
    - text: Secured by hark has end-to-end encryption so your data stays safe. You’ll want to connect accounts, save logins, and make payments on Hark. That’s a lot of info you’re trusting us with. Think of this as a vault that absolutely no person has access to. Plus, Hark checks in with you before doing something that requires your approval.
    - img "Rest assured it's Secured by hark"
    - heading "Tap it off your list" [level=2]
    - text: Hark’s Action Buttons are the to-do list you’ve always dreamed of. Hark suggests and prioritizes these based on what it knows you have on your plate. All you have to do is click on it and Hark will perform that action from start to finish.
    - img "Tap it off your list"
    - heading "Thanks, it’s custom" [level=2]
    - text: Create your own customized Panels to stay on top of whatever you like. All you do is describe what you want and Hark will build mini-apps completely tailored to you. You can ask your Panels questions to dig deeper into their data, unlocking even more from services you already use like Strava, Spotify, and Venmo.
    - img "Thanks, it’s custom"
    - heading "Epic Capability. Enterprise Security." [level=2]
    - button "Security at Hark"
    - heading "At Hark, we are building the most personal, human-like intelligence in the world." [level=2]
    - button "Our Manifesto"
    - heading "Sign up for Hark" [level=2]
    - button "Continue with Google"
    - button "Continue with Apple"
    - text: or
    - textbox "Email address or phone number"
    - button "Continue"
